fields.System.Title: RET-104 — Expire an unused RMA
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a returns clerk, I want old unused RMAs closed automatically, so that the open list
reflects what is genuinely expected back.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an RMA past its expiry with no receipts, then a scheduled job closes it as
  • expired.
  • - Given a partly received RMA past its expiry, then it is closed for the outstanding
  • quantity only.
  • - Given an expired RMA, then goods arriving against it are handled as a blind return —
  • see [RET-202](RET-202-blind-return.md).
  • - Given expiry, then the customer service team can see which RMAs expired and when.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns |
| Tables | rma |
| Risks | Open RMA list growing until it is useless |
| Tests | integration |
